title: Responsibility for the origins of the Cold War
stem: Paper 2 essay practice on the Cold War. Plan for about 45 minutes.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Evaluate the claim that the USA was mainly responsible for the breakdown of relations with the USSR between 1945 and 1949.
markscheme: Introduction with a clear thesis on responsibility and definition of the period
Case for US responsibility: Truman's tougher stance, atomic monopoly, ending of Lend-Lease
Truman Doctrine (1947) and Marshall Plan seen by Moscow as economic and political expansion; revisionist view (W.A. Williams, Kolko)
Western currency reform in Germany (1948) provoking the Berlin Blockade; formation of NATO (1949)
Case for Soviet responsibility: domination of Eastern Europe, rigged Polish elections, Czech coup (1948); orthodox view
Stalin's blockade of Berlin and refusal of Marshall aid; Cominform (1947)
Mutual misperception and security dilemma; post-revisionist view (Gaddis)
Post-1991 archival evidence and Gaddis' 'We Now Know' renewing emphasis on Stalin
Precise evidence and dates used to support analysis
Conclusion that evaluates the claim and reaches a supported judgement
parts.notes: Real essays are marked out of 15; this practice version uses a 10-point checklist. Historiography should support, not replace, your own argument.
